# Summit War

## Sabaody Archipelago

Every crew bound for the New World waits here for its coating. So do the Marines, the slave traders and the Celestial Dragons.

Reach 12,500 Doriki and land on the Sabaody Archipelago. It is the most crowded island on the server.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Thriller Bark](03_paradise.md#q-1bd24a9deb20f360)

**Tasks**

- Reach 12,500 Doriki
- Land on the Sabaody Archipelago

**Rewards**

- Doriki +600, Belly +40,000, Haki +5 Busoshoku / +5 Kenbunshoku, +1 Training Points (your style), Paradise Crate

<a id="q-3dddf57c2bab7b82"></a>

## Kuma's Paws

**Optional quest.**

Bartholomew Kuma scattered a whole crew across the world with a slap. His Pacifista copies hunt rookies on the archipelago.

Destroy two Pacifista.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Sabaody Archipelago](04_summit_war.md#q-16f410ad3a59c0e0)

**Tasks**

- Destroy 2 Pacifista

**Rewards**

- Doriki +480, Belly +35,000, Haki +5 Busoshoku / +5 Kenbunshoku, +1 Training Points (your style)

## Amazon Lily

No wind, no current and Sea Kings in every direction. The Kuja warriors of Amazon Lily cross the Calm Belt on boats pulled by sea serpents.

Land on a jungle island in Paradise and complete the Log Pose missions of a jungle island in Paradise.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Sabaody Archipelago](04_summit_war.md#q-16f410ad3a59c0e0)

**Tasks**

- Land on a jungle island in Paradise
- Complete the Log Pose missions of a jungle island in Paradise

**Rewards**

- Doriki +600, Belly +35,000, Haki +5 Busoshoku / +5 Kenbunshoku, +1 Training Points (your style)

<a id="q-6412a97f7114481f"></a>

## Impel Down

The great underwater prison has six levels, each worse than the one above, and the deepest is not on any official map. Its Gates of Justice stand in the Calm Belts.

Reach 25,000 Doriki, go through a Gate of Justice, and fight your way down to Level 6, Eternal Hell.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Amazon Lily](04_summit_war.md#q-534c643f85417684)

**Tasks**

- Reach 25,000 Doriki
- Go through a Gate of Justice
- Get down to Level 6: Eternal Hell

**Rewards**

- Doriki +780, Belly +60,000, Haki +10 Busoshoku / +10 Kenbunshoku, +1 Training Points (your style), Prisoner's Shirt

<a id="q-3332a4f7d17bcc53"></a>

## The Summit War of Marineford

Whitebeard sailed into Marineford with forty-three crews to save one man. Every Marine in the world was waiting for him.

This is a server-wide event. Together the server must defeat 1,000 Marines, pirates, revolutionaries or bandits on Marineford, and you must land at least 30 of those blows yourself. Pirates and Marines will meet here, and PvP is on.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Impel Down](04_summit_war.md#q-6412a97f7114481f)

**Tasks**

- Land on Marineford
- Server: 1,000 battles won on Marineford (30 yours)

**Rewards**

- Doriki +1,080, Belly +80,000, Haki +10 Busoshoku / +10 Kenbunshoku, +1 Training Points (your style), Iron Box

<a id="q-326cc60a9438ed03"></a>

## Two Years Later

After Marineford, Luffy rang the bell at Marineford sixteen times and the crew vanished for two years of training.

Reach 27,500 Doriki and train both Busoshoku and Kenbunshoku Haki to 150. The New World does not forgive the unprepared.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [The Summit War of Marineford](04_summit_war.md#q-3332a4f7d17bcc53)

**Tasks**

- Reach 27,500 Doriki
- Reach 150 Busoshoku Haki EXP
- Reach 150 Kenbunshoku Haki EXP

**Rewards**

- Doriki +600, Belly +60,000, Haki +10 Busoshoku / +10 Kenbunshoku, +1 Training Points (your style)

<a id="q-2a0c374517b91851"></a>

## Rock Bottom

Below the last cells, Impel Down's warden keeps the worst criminals the world ever caught. Nobody has walked out past him.

Get down to Level 6 and kill the warden of Impel Down.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Impel Down](04_summit_war.md#q-6412a97f7114481f)

**Tasks**

- Get to Level 6 and kill the warden

**Rewards**

- Doriki +900, Belly +90,000, Haki +10 Busoshoku / +10 Kenbunshoku, +1 Training Points (your style), Iron Box

<a id="q-6f62317e161b0283"></a>

## The Gate of Hell

Not every gate in the Calm Belt leads to a prison. On the island the Marines call the Gate of Hell, a ruined gate opens on the Nether itself.

Finish the Gate of Hell's Log Pose mission, then go through into the Nether. The gate lets nobody through below a quarter of the Doriki cap or without awakened Haki.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Amazon Lily](04_summit_war.md#q-534c643f85417684)

**Tasks**

- Finish the Gate of Hell's mission
- Enter the Nether

**Rewards**

- Doriki +600, Belly +40,000, Haki +5 Busoshoku / +5 Kenbunshoku
